newsitem.title: CHINA: Chueng Kong says adds 222 flats for sale.
newsitem.headline: Chueng Kong says adds 222 flats for sale.

text.p: Cheung Kong Holdings Ltd said on Thursday it would offer an extra 222 flats for sale at its residential development in Shatin in the New Territories because of good response.

The property developer already offered an additional 263 units for sale to its first batch of 204 flats available at Vista Paradiso, a joint venture project equally owned by Cheung Kong and Concord Land Development Co Ltd.
The additional 222 units will be priced at HK$6,820 per square foot, while the 470 units would be sold from HK$6,148 to HK$6,677 per square foot.
The units will be sold on July 26.
Vista Paradiso has about 2,030 residential units.
